title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I checked your numbers and you make fair points about the material index and our delivery last quarter. I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR for 35 days lead time to beat that other offer, but we must keep payment at 30 days. We need the cash flowing to keep the shop running smoothly for you.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

thank you for your revised quote and for checking our data. The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months, DAP Hollerau, with the 35-day lead time you confirmed.

A valid competing offer is EUR 30.5 per unit (offer:70250-1); please improve your complete package.

At our supplier day you described Hollerau as an important reference customer. The HX series gives you a steady load for your free capacity. One package has shorter payment terms, which would help your cash flow.

Which package suits you best? Is there a cheaper variant you would propose?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. 

The 14 days payment term is exactly what we need right now to keep the cash flowing. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. I can do 28.50 EUR per piece if we lock in the 14 days payment and 35 days lead time. So, our offer is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.body:

That quality record is old news and already baked in. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? If you want to save money with a larger lot size, you need to give us the engineering green light like I said before. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Gruß
